title: Store, checkout, digital delivery và memberships
scope_items: Database Migration 00030: Created store_pages (§19.3), membership_plans (§19.4), membership_subscriptions (§19.4B), and digital_deliveries tables with workspace composite tenant keys, strict tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), check constraints, and narrow role-based grants.

Acceptance Target 1 (Bundle stock atomic): Bundle component inventory checks and deductions are completely atomic. If ANY component has insufficient stock, the bundle is marked unavailable with an explicit explanation and checkout fails closed with zero leaked reservations; verified under high concurrency races.

Acceptance Target 2 (Payment replay no duplicate delivery): Replaying checkout with the same idempotency key or payment intent ID returns existing order and digital delivery tokens without creating duplicate deliveries, double-deducting stock, or double-posting to the ledger.

Acceptance Target 3 (Buyer subscription cannot unlock SaaS privileges): Creator store buyer memberships (membership_subscriptions) grant audience perks (exclusive content, discounts) but strictly CANNOT grant SaaS workspace permissions (store:manage, product:manage, workspace:admin, billing:manage, etc.).

Store Builder, Custom Domains & SEO (RULE-M15-001, RULE-M15-004): Page lifecycle (draft -> published -> hidden -> retired), custom domain binding, slug uniqueness within workspace, and layout block customization.
Creator Memberships & MRR (RULE-M15-003): Plan creation, interval pricing, subscriber counts, and MRR analytics with exact NUMERIC(18,6) calculations without float errors.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_BundleStockAtomic (Go 40-goroutine concurrent race test with -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter mobile test suite confirm atomic stock checking, explicit component failure explanation, and zero inventory leakage.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_PaymentReplayNoDuplicateDelivery (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm exact delivery token deduplication and zero duplicate stock deduction on replay.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_BuyerSubscriptionCannotUnlockSaaSPrivileges (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm complete RBAC isolation between store buyers and workspace SaaS operators.
Migration 00030 Verified: Migrator test suite (migrator_test.go) passes all 30 migrations up, status verification, and clean down transactional reversal. check_d0.sh passes.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, and Dart test suites.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: Vitest web test suite (20 tests in store.test.ts passing), svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), Vite production build (adapter-node ✔ done), SSR smoke test (200 OK across routes), and Flutter test suite (220+ tests passing, flutter analyze 0 issues).
